def: military service, i.e. (figuratively) the apostolic career (as one of hardship and danger)

occurrences.text: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
